title: Integrative Diagnosis for SCD and Other RADs
official: Integrative Diagnosis of Sickle Cell Disease (SCD) and Other Rare Anemia Disorders (RADs) for Personalized Medicine
summary: INTEGRA aims at enabling personalized medicine for RADs patients by the establishment of an integrative diagnostic approach based on deep phenotypic and genetic characterization through combining new generation methodologies.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Patients sustaining a confirmed or suspected diagnosis of an hereditary rare hemolytic anemia:

Sickle cell disease (SCD) Thalassaemia syndromes Congenital dyserythropoietic anaemia (CDA) Enzymopathies Unstable haemoglobin / altered oxygen affinity Hereditary stomatocytosis Hereditary pyropoikilocytosis

Hereditary spherocytosis (HS), either severe (baseline Hb \<10 g/dL or transfusion-dependent) or with an inconclusive diagnosis:

Patient with chronic haemolytic anaemia and a compatible red cell smear, but with:

EMA binding test: inconclusive or negative Genetic testing: no definitive diagnosis (VUS or no findings)

Exclusion Criteria:

* Carrier traits in autosomal recessive hereditary anemias
